description: This file implements an Azure-specific OpenAI language model service within the Pipecat AI framework. It defines the AzureLLMService class, which extends the existing OpenAILLMService to connect to Azure's OpenAI endpoints using the AsyncAzureOpenAI client.

classes.description: A service for interacting with Azure OpenAI using the OpenAI-compatible interface, extending OpenAILLMService for Azure endpoints.
